sloka: सामया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः ।एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा ।। ५.५८.५९ ।।।।
transliteration: sāmayā rākṣasīmadhye tarjyamānā muhurmuhuḥ ।ekaveṇīdharā dīnā bhartṛcintāparāyaṇā ।। 5.58.59 ।।।।

translations.english: After much searching I at last beheld her amid the demonesses, repeatedly intimidated—wearing a single braid, miserable, absorbed in thought of her husband, pale from lying on the bare ground like a lotus at winter's onset, turned away from Ravana and resolved to die.
